# CLI Reference

## Commands

- [lattice workspace open](lattice-workspace-open/) — Open and index a canonical workspace.
- [lattice workspace status](lattice-workspace-status/) — Inspect canonical workspace identity and index status.
- [lattice index](lattice-index/) — Incrementally ingest and index a workspace.
- [lattice search](lattice-search/) — Search indexed project names, symbols, paths, and source.
- [lattice studio list](lattice-studio-list/) — List discoverable Studio sessions and platform resolution state.
- [lattice studio environment](lattice-studio-environment/) — Inspect native Studio environments and path capabilities.
- [lattice studio mcp](lattice-studio-mcp/) — Inspect or run the read-only live Studio MCP proof.
- [lattice studio pull](lattice-studio-pull/) — Pull Luau source from the connected Studio into a native place.json workspace.
- [lattice provider list](lattice-provider-list/) — List registered providers without connecting them.
- [lattice provider inspect](lattice-provider-inspect/) — Inspect one provider descriptor and health model.
- [lattice tool search](lattice-tool-search/) — Search the unified provider tool catalog.
- [lattice tool inspect](lattice-tool-inspect/) — Inspect one exact tool reference and its schemas.
- [lattice capability list](lattice-capability-list/) — List registered semantic capabilities.
- [lattice mcp stdio](lattice-mcp-stdio/) — Forward Codex and other MCP clients to the authoritative daemon.
- [lattice mcp status](lattice-mcp-status/) — Inspect local daemon and northbound MCP availability.
- [lattice integration codex install](lattice-integration-codex-install/) — Configure Codex CLI's global Lattice MCP server entry.
- [lattice integration codex status](lattice-integration-codex-status/) — Verify Codex installation and daemon reachability.
- [lattice integration codex remove](lattice-integration-codex-remove/) — Remove only the Lattice MCP entry from Codex.
